name: Pohledy (Czechia)
description: Three horizontal stripes of red, yellow and red in the ratio 1:1:1, with a black triangle issuing from the hoist edge in the yellow and three apples, yellow in the red and red in the yellow, one above the other.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 31 January 2002 and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
